List domains#

get/v1/projects/{id}/domains

List domains associated with the project. Required permission: domain.list.

Parâmetros de caminho

idstring (uuid)obrigatório

Parâmetros de consulta

pageinteger

Padrão: 1

limitinteger

Padrão: 10

Exemplo
curl -X GET "https://api.trackup.me/v1/projects/{id}/domains" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY"
Respostas
200object

Successful response.

Create a domain#

post/v1/projects/{id}/domains

Associate a hostname with the project and register it with Cloudflare when configured. Required permission: domain.create.

Parâmetros de caminho

idstring (uuid)obrigatório

Corpo da requisição

hostnamestringobrigatório

Apex domain or subdomain the links will answer on (example.com, go.example.com), without http(s)://, www. or any path.

Exemplo
curl -X POST "https://api.trackup.me/v1/projects/{id}/domains" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "hostname": "string"
}'
Respostas

Created successfully.

Update a domain#

patch/v1/projects/{id}/domains/{domainId}

Promote a verified domain to primary. Directly unsetting the primary domain is rejected. Required permission: domain.update.

Parâmetros de caminho

idstring (uuid)obrigatório
domainIdstring (uuid)obrigatório

Corpo da requisição

isPrimaryboolean
Exemplo
curl -X PATCH "https://api.trackup.me/v1/projects/{id}/domains/{domainId}" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "isPrimary": true
}'
Respostas

Verify a domain#
